messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 doesn't know how to deal with data of class factor (multiple trajectories in one plot)
parts:
Is datax a data.frame? I think it's complaining because you're handing it a vector of factors as a data.frame. Case in point, in your example, datax$time does not appear to exist. 

On Sun, Jul 15, 2012 at 7:05 PM, Torvon <eiko....@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello, 

I'm trying to create a trajectory plot (spaghetti plot) with 9 different trajectories over time. The relevant columns are 
PHQ = ordered dependent variable (ranging from 0 to 3), the score on an item on the questionnaire PHQ
PHQ_index = the number of the item
time 

Data are in long long format: person, within time, within the 9 phq items.
So every person has ( time=5 * phq categories =9 ) == 45 lines.
Line01 Person1: time=1, phq_index=1, PHQ=…
Line02 Person1: time=1, phq_index=2, PHQ=…
Line03 Person1: time=1, phq_index=3, PHQ=…
Line04 Person1: time=1, phq_index=4, PHQ=…
Line05 Person1: time=1, phq_index=5, PHQ=…
Line06 Person1: time=1, phq_index=6, PHQ=…
Line07 Person1: time=1, phq_index=7, PHQ=…
Line08 Person1: time=1, phq_index=8, PHQ=…
Line09 Person1: time=1, phq_index=9, PHQ=…
Line10 Person1: time=2, phq_index=1, PHQ=…
...


datax <-datax[is.na(datax$PHQ)==FALSE,]
-> work, kick out missing values.

datax <- factor(datax$PHQ_index, 
        levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8),
        labels = c("phq1", "phq2", "phq3", "phq4", "phq5", "phq6", "phq7", "phq8", "phq9"))
-> works

p <- ggplot(datax, aes(time, as.factor(PHQ), color = PHQ_index)) + 
  stat_summary(geom = "line", fun.y = "mean")
-> Error: ggplot2 doesn't know how to deal with data of class factor

Thanks

On 2012-Jul-15, at 20:05 , Torvon wrote:
>
> datax <- factor(datax$PHQ_index,
> levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8),
> labels = c("phq1", "phq2", "phq3", "phq4", "phq5", "phq6", "phq7", "phq8", "phq9"))
> -> works

Here you want:

datax$PHQ_index <- factor(datax$PHQ_index, ...

Currently you are converting one column of datax and overwriting *all* of datax with it. And since datax is not a data.frame anymore this:

> p <- ggplot(datax, aes(time, as.factor(PHQ), color = PHQ_index)) +
> stat_summary(geom = "line", fun.y = "mean")
> -> Error: ggplot2 doesn't know how to deal with data of class factor

happens.
